description: This file defines a Svelte component for managing and displaying a list of boards in a task management application. It includes functionality for loading, creating, renaming, deleting, and reordering boards, as well as selecting a specific board to view its details and associated tasks.

methods.name: initBoards
methods.description: Fetches the list of boards from the API, sorts them, and sets the initial selected board.

methods.name: handleCreateBoard
methods.description: Creates a new board with the specified title and description, then updates the boards list.

methods.name: startRename
methods.description: Initiates the renaming process for a specific board.

methods.name: handleRenameBoard
methods.description: Updates the title of a specified board and updates the local state.

methods.name: handleDeleteBoard
methods.description: Deletes a specified board after user confirmation and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: selectBoard
methods.description: Sets the selected board by ID.

methods.name: handleDnd
methods.description: Handles the reordering of boards via drag-and-drop, updating their order in the backend.

methods.name: reloadSelectedBoard
methods.description: Refetches the data for the currently selected board from the API.
